crossRefs.note: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.
